clone_head_note: the canonical outputs were committed from this clone after the run, so its HEAD is the commit that holds them; the code that ran is the git sha in the manifests
data_note: data/ was a symbolic link to the main repository's cached downloads (data/raw, data/cache): this run proves that the committed code regenerates every result from cached raw data; that the downloads themselves reproduce is shown by the from-scratch clone (results/repro/repro_summary.json)
tests_note: make all runs the tests first, i.e. before the upgrades rewrite their run_manifest.json files
home_path_note: relative paths in these manifests resolve through the data/ link into the main repository (../../Users/...), which tests/test_manifests.py rejects as absolute paths
